name: Back to Thunder Bluff
summary: Your return from Moonglade brings you back to Elder Rise, where Turak Runetotem awaits. Dendrite Starblaze sends you home after your communion with the Great Bear Spirit, so your training can continue among your people.

sections.title: A Bridged Fellowship
sections.body: Moonglade brings night elf and tauren practitioners of nature magic together in the Cenarion Circle, apart from the mortal world’s factional divides. After your communion with the Great Bear Spirit, Dendrite Starblaze sends you back to your people. Night elves often see tauren as fledglings in Cenarius’s formal teachings, yet Starblaze recognizes the wisdom and balance of Turak Runetotem.

sections.title: Return to the Bluffs
sections.body: You climb back to Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and stand before Turak Runetotem, changed by your rite. Communion with ancient totemic spirits such as the Great Bear Spirit runs deep in tauren culture, but the Path of the Claw asks for serious commitment. Your spiritual bond is forged, and Turak prepares you to put your new strength and endurance into practice.

faq.q: Why was a night elf teaching a tauren in Moonglade?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle is neutral and devoted to preserving nature. In Moonglade, night elf and tauren practitioners set aside the Horde and Alliance divide, so Dendrite Starblaze can guide young tauren druids.

Turak Runetotem is an esteemed tauren druid and one of the Arch Druid’s assistants. He is stationed on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, where he trains young tauren in the path of nature and the claw and links them with the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: What did the young druid do right before this quest?
aliases: what came before back to thunder bluff
faq.answer: Before returning to Mulgore, you traveled to Moonglade to seek and commune with the ancient Great Bear Spirit. You gained its blessing and learned the spiritual core of bear form.

faq.q: How do young druids travel back to Thunder Bluff from Moonglade?
aliases: how to get back from moonglade
faq.answer: Bunthen Plainswind, in southwestern Nighthaven, offers flight services to carry tauren druids safely back to Thunder Bluff after their rites.

faq.q: What comes next in the druid's training?
faq.answer: After your return, Turak Runetotem sends you to face a physical challenge at the Moonkin Stone, where the Barrens meet Mulgore. There you prove you can channel the spirit’s strength into beast form.

faq.q: Why does Dendrite Starblaze call tauren 'young in the ways of Cenarius'?
faq.answer: Tauren legends tell of ancient communion with Cenarius at the dawn of the world, while night elves developed and sustained formal Cenarion druidism for over ten thousand years. Tauren only recently renewed structured study within the Cenarion Circle.

angles.text: As a druid, your journey links Moonglade with the heights of Thunder Bluff and marks your growth along the Path of the Claw.
As a tauren, you bring the wisdom of the ancient spirits home to help and protect your tribes across Mulgore.
As a member of the Horde, you help bring shapeshifting defenders to its ranks on the plains of Kalimdor.
